name: Clustered Principal Component Analysis (CPCA)
aliases: Clustered Principal Component Analysis (CPCA) for Visibility
Clustered Principal Component Analysis (CPCA) for Visibility Compression
Visibility Compression via Clustered Principal Component Analysis (CPCA)
definition: A method to compress visibility data by partitioning the domain into angular tiles and applying PCA to clusters of tiles covering the same subset of the domain, allowing early culling of visible/occluded tiles.
summary: Clustered Principal Component Analysis compresses visibility data by partitioning the angular domain into tiles and applying PCA to clusters, exploiting spatial and angular locality to reduce memory cost while preserving visual quality.
